policy: A field is verified only when the consulted source directly supports it. A record is not promoted to fully verified when important fields remain unsupported or conflicting.

records.name: Divinity Unleashed
verified_fields: 25% first-clear slot reported by research source
remaining: independent confirmation of exact Ki behavior/cost and all mechanics
records.notes: PQ 110 research directly lists Divinity Unleashed as a skill reward with a 25% first-clear slot. The record remains partially verified because this pass did not independently verify every gameplay field.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist
records.notes: Two sources agree on Skill Shop acquisition, Strike Super classification, 100 Ki and the three-hit rush. The repository claim that the move appears after a specific story chapter is not promoted without stronger current evidence.

records.name: God Splitter
remaining: exact lesson numbering in current game
records.notes: The consulted sources establish Zamasu training and the core projectile/guard-cancel behavior. The repository's exact lesson numbering should remain unpromoted until reconciled.

records.name: Kaioken Assault
records.notes: The Steam patch notice confirms a historical reduction in the attack's Ki requirement from 500 to 200. The current wiki page still marks acquisition as TBA, so the repository's Skill Shop/story unlock claim is not promoted to verified.

records.name: Burst Rush
verified_fields: Gohan Adult and DBS Super Hero variants
records.notes: Sources agree on PQ 51, the counter behavior, 100 Ki, four-hit rush and variant behavior. The repository's 30% drop figure is not promoted because the consulted sources did not establish that exact probability.
